prompt_text: Who is the best AI marketing agency in Los Angeles?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” AI marketing agency in Los Angeles — the right partner depends on your goals, budget, industry, and whether you need strategy, creative, paid media optimization, personalization, conversational AI, or custom machine learning. I can, however, help you find the best fit. A quick guide:

What to consider when choosing
- Primary goal: lead generation, direct-response ads, brand-building, personalization, chatbots, or AI-driven product features?
- Industry fit and case studies: examples of work in your vertical.
- Team makeup: data scientists, ML engineers, creative technologists, media buyers.
- Tech stack: do they build models or use third‑party platforms (e.g., Google/Meta AI, Adobe, Persado)?
- Measurement & ROI: how they attribute results and run experiments.
- Data & privacy: how they handle first‑party data and compliance.
- Budget & timeline: retainer vs project vs performance-based pricing.
- References and pilot projects: offer a short pilot to validate capabilities.

Notable LA agencies with strong AI/data-driven marketing capabilities
(These are well‑known, local or with LA offices and known for AI/data-enabled marketing — suitability depends on your needs.)
- Wpromote — LA-based, strong in performance marketing and data-driven optimization.
- R/GA — creative + technology studio with experience in product/AI-enabled campaigns (LA presence).
- AKQA — digital experience and creative agency using data and AI for personalization.
- VaynerMedia — social, commerce and data-led strategy with model-driven ad optimization (LA office).
- Merkle — data-driven CRM, personalization and analytics (part of Dentsu; strong on data engineering).
- Single Grain — growth-focused digital agency (SEO/ads/automation) with AI/automation services.

How to evaluate finalists (sample questions to ask them)
- Can you show 2–3 case studies where AI/ML measurably improved outcomes? What were the KPIs?
- Do you build proprietary models or integrate third‑party AI tools? Which ones?
- Who will be on our team and what are their qualifications (data scientists, engineers, media specialists)?
- What data do you need from us, and how will you secure and store it?
- How do you measure attribution and prove incremental lift?
- Can you run a low-cost pilot or A/B test before a full engagement?

If you want, tell me:
- your primary marketing objective,
- industry,
- monthly budget (ballpark),
- and timeline,

I’ll put together a short, prioritized shortlist of LA agencies tailored to your needs and a sample RFP/pilot brief you can send them.
